## Adult River Dragon (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
 CN Large dragon (aquatic, fire)  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** dragon senses, watersight; Perception +25; **Aura** boiling (5 ft., 1d6 fire), frightful presence (180 ft., DC 20)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 29, touch 11, flat-footed 28 (+1 Dex, +19 natural, -1 size)  
 **hp** 161 (14d12+70)  
 **Fort** +14, **Ref** +10, **Will** +13  
 **DR** 5/magic; **Immune** fire, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 22  
 **Weaknesses** Vulnerable to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +21 (2d6+10), tail +16 (1d8+10)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (80-ft. line, DC 22, 12d6 fire)  
 **Spell-like Abilities** (CL 14th)  

  At will— *[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*, *[soften earth and stone](../../magic/spells/soften-earth-and-stone.md)*, *[water breathing](../../magic/spells/water-breathing.md)*  

 **Spells Known (CL 5th)**  

  2nd (5/day)— (DC 15) *[cat’s grace](../../magic/spells/cats-grace.md)*, *[resist energy](../../magic/spells/resist-energy.md)*  
 1st (7/day)— (DC 14) *[expeditious retreat](../../magic/spells/expeditious-retreat.md)*, *[identify](../../magic/spells/identify.md)*, *[reduce person](../../magic/spells/reduce-person.md)*  
 0 (at will)— *[arcane mark](../../magic/spells/arcane-mark.md)*, *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 25, **Dex** 13, **Con** 20, **Int** 15, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 16  
 **Base Atk** +14; **CMB** +22; **CMD** 33 (cannot be tripped)  
 **Feats** Alertness, Athletic, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Initiative, Power Attack  
 **Skills** Appraise +19, Intimidate +20, Knowledge (nature) +19, Perception +25, Spellcraft +19, Stealth +14, Survival, +21, Swim +24  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic, Sylvan  
 **SQ** air breathing, speak with aquatic, watersight  

**Special Abilities**

 **Air Breathing (Ex)**  The river dragon can breathe air just as naturally as water. This dragon can freely use its breath weapon, spells and other abilities in both air and water.  

 **Speak with Aquatic (Ex)**  The young and older river dragon gains a constant spell-like ability to *speak with animals* of the aquatic subtype. This otherwise functions as *speak with animals*.  

 **Watersight (Ex)**  The very young and older river dragon can see underwater four times better than a human.

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate aquatic  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
